}}'''Adrielle''' is an [[Aes Sedai]] of the [[Gray Ajah]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Adrielle}}

==Appearance==
She is tall and beautiful.{{ref|{{twotc}}, Adrielle|Adrielle}} She is taller than [[Mezar Kurin]], the Asha'man she is bonded to.{{ref/book|11|27}}.

==Activities==
She has remained loyal to the [[White Tower]] during the split.

She was one of fifty-one sisters sent to destroy the [[Black Tower]]{{ref/book|7|p}}. They were, however, all captured and bonded by the [[Asha'man]]{{ref/book|8|26}}. Adrielle is bonded to [[Mezar Kurin]]. She has become quite friendly with Kurin even though she was bonded against her will{{ref/book|11|27}}.


Elaida abandons the Aes Sedai sent to capture the Black Tower, including Toveine, at [[Alviarin]]'s suggestion {{ref/book|7|32}}.

She has [[Travel]]ed with Kurin to [[Tear]] to join up with [[Rand al'Thor]]. 
She watches Rand's meeting with the [[Daughter of the Nine Moons]] from a distance and Travels in as backup when it is revealed that the Daughter of the Nine Moons is actually [[Semirhage]]{{ref/book|11|27}}.

She vanished after Kurin was [[Turned]]. She was, presumably, also Turned.{{ref||Adrielle}}
